description: Cheapest return flights from any airport/city IATA code ($0.01): up to 30 destinations with lowest fare, dates, stops, airline, and booking link. $0.01 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

currency.description: currency code, e.g. EUR or USD

origin.description: 3-letter IATA airport/city code, e.g. MAD, LPA, LON

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
